key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the anarthrous Son expression, inheritance and creation of the ages.
key_decisions.before: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of everything, through whom also he made the ages.
key_decisions.after: In these last days, he has spoken to us through a Son, whom he appointed heir of all things and through whom he also made the ages.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the ages.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves radiance/imprint images, cosmic sustaining and enthronement after purification.
key_decisions.before: He is the radiance of the glory of God and the exact imprint of his being, and he upholds everything by the word of his power. After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
key_decisions.after: The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the exact imprint of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He is the radiance of the glory of God and the exact imprint of his being, and he upholds all things by the word of his power. After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains rhetorical question and both kinship quotations.
key_decisions.before: For to which of the angels did God ever say, “You are my Son, today I have begotten you”? Or again, “I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son”?
key_decisions.after: For to which of the angels did God ever say, “You are my Son; today I have fathered you”? Or again, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son”?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For to which of the angels did God ever say, “You are my Son, today I have begotten you”? Or again, “I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son”?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps firstborn title, world entrance and angelic worship.
key_decisions.before: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the world, he says, “Let all God’s angels worship him.”
key_decisions.after: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the inhabited world, he says, “Let all God's angels worship him.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the world, he says, “Let all God’s angels worship him.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps direct divine address and rule imagery.
key_decisions.before: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom.
key_decisions.after: But about the Son: “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, and the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves doubled God language, anointing and comparison.
key_decisions.before: You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions.”
key_decisions.after: You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of joy beyond your companions.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves enthronement, enemies and subjugating footstool image.
key_decisions.before: And to which of the angels has he ever said, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet”?
key_decisions.after: And to which of the angels has he ever said, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet”?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And to which of the angels has he ever said, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet”?
